The '''Belkadan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]] of the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]].
